description.value: Chuan Siang Kitchen (傳香) is a Taiwanese restaurant serving bento-style meals and seasonal specials in a Richmond strip mall. The shop has an active social media presence with over 2,400 followers and earns a 100% recommendation rate from reviewers. A touring cyclist stopping in Richmond's suburban west end will find quick, affordable Taiwanese comfort food with in-store pickup available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 37m; rack (covered) at 59m; rack at 84m; rack at 91m.

Recent posts ('4h' ago) confirm the business is open. The OSM URL points to the Facebook page rather than the primary business website (potelicious.ca), and OSM tags list cuisine as 'chinese' while Facebook categorizes it as 'Taiwanese Restaurant'. In-store pickup is explicitly listed on the Facebook page, confirming takeout service; no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
